source_instruction: i am looking for a low carbohydrates protein bar with package of 12 counts.
query: I just spent the last 20 minutes chasing my escaped house gecko around the living room, he snuck out of his terrarium when I was refilling his water dish and hid under the throw blanket on the couch. I also realized I forgot to grab the extra crickets I ordered for him from the front porch when I got home yesterday, I hope the raccoons didn’t tear into the bag overnight. Oh, and my roommate left their half-eaten matcha popsicle melting on the coffee table again, that’s gonna leave a sticky ring for sure. Anyway, can you help me find low carb, 12 count breakfast foods? I don’t want to spend too much on them.
